title: Article numbers and pack sizes on one recipe model
signal: The November 2025 packages count a recipe as one model, with pack sizes and article numbers free; the product had to match the price list
summary: Attach any number of article numbers and pack sizes to one recipe.

title: Active supplier counter for add on blocks
signal: Supplier engagement became an add on sold in blocks of 25 active suppliers a year (November 2025)
summary: Shows how many suppliers are active against the customer's blocks.

title: Supplier links work for 60 days without a login
signal: CS feedback in Q4 2025: farms gave up at the login screen
summary: A supplier opens the request from the email and answers without creating an account.

title: Factor library 2026.1: more than 5,000 ingredient factors
signal: Planned quarterly factor release; partner data for bakery and ready meal inputs
summary: About 1,100 new factors, taking the library from about 4,000 past 5,000.

title: One page board summary for each reporting year
signal: Q4 2025 reviews: champions rebuilding the same board slide by hand every year; later, 'My board can see a PDF' (Bergstrand, 18 Aug)
summary: A one page PDF of the year's total, the movement and the main sources, for a board pack.

title: Supplier requests in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish and English
signal: Nordic groups sending requests to suppliers outside Sweden (Q4 2025)
summary: The supplier request and form appear in the supplier's language.

title: Recipe import from Excel, with sub recipes
signal: Onboarding feedback: recipes arrive in Excel nine times out of ten
summary: Import recipes and sub recipes from a spreadsheet instead of typing them in.

title: Rank suppliers by emissions
signal: Group customers in Q4 2025 reviews: where do we start with suppliers?
summary: A sort option that ranks suppliers by their share of emissions. The screen still opened alphabetically by default, which became D-02.

title: Choose operational or financial control per entity
signal: Group customers preparing their first assured reports (BLOG-2, November 2025)
summary: Set the consolidation approach entity by entity, shown in the method note.

title: Method notes in English as well as Swedish
signal: Customers sending method notes to buyers and auditors outside Sweden
summary: Every method note can be produced in English.

title: Co product allocation for dairy, milling and meat
signal: Onboarding feedback from dairies and mills on whey, bran and by products
summary: Split a process's emissions across its co products by mass, economic value or a custom key.

title: Group overview: every entity's total on one page
signal: Group sustainability leads asked for one screen before quarterly reviews
summary: One page with each entity's total, its data coverage and what changed since the last review.

title: Automatic reminders to suppliers who have not answered
signal: Customers chasing suppliers by hand (P-02)
summary: Scheduled, polite reminders, stopped as soon as the supplier answers.

title: Entity contacts upload their own activity data, with reminders
signal: The data sits with somebody else (P-09); chasing entities takes a group lead's January
summary: Each entity's contact gets a request and uploads their own data.

title: Single product what if: compare two origins side by side
signal: Spring requests for 'what do we do about it' (P-04); the smallest answer product could give without a new module
summary: On one product, swap an ingredient's origin and see the two footprints side by side.

title: Compare two suppliers of the same material side by side
signal: Group customers asking which of two suppliers to favour
summary: Two suppliers of one material on one screen, with the difference in emissions.

title: What's new panel in the app
signal: Customers hearing about changes late or not at all (Q1 reviews); release notes went by email only
summary: Release notes inside the product, shown once to each user.

title: Accept a certificate or EPD as declared supplier data
signal: Suppliers sending certificates instead of filling in the form
summary: Upload a supplier's certificate and record its figure as declared.

title: Seasonal sourcing: origin share by quarter
signal: Sourcing that changes by quarter (company file); seed and grain mixes that follow supply
summary: Set each ingredient's origin mix per quarter instead of one mix for the year.

title: Single sign on on the Supply and Group packages
signal: IT and security questionnaires in procurement asking for single sign on; by September reps answer 'yes on single sign on for your plan' (Klarälven, 8 Sep)
summary: Log in through the customer's own identity provider. Customers still on the old module contracts get it when they move to a package at renewal.

title: Factor library 2026.2: dairy and grain partner data
signal: Planned quarterly factor release
summary: About 650 new factors from partner data for dairy and grain.

title: Farm level records for cooperatives and growers
signal: Dairies working on the farm and land target (BLOG-1); cooperatives with dozens of farms
summary: Record each farm behind a cooperative as its own supplier, with its own data.

title: Data coverage by emissions weight, not line count
signal: Assurance providers and boards asking how much of the number rests on real data
summary: Show the share of the footprint covered by primary, regional and global data, weighted by emissions.

title: Add an entity part way through the year
signal: Groups buying a company mid year and restating around it
summary: Bring an acquired entity in from a date, with the boundary change disclosed.

title: Recipe versions: see what changed and when
signal: 'You open it when a recipe changes' (Smakbolaget); customers losing track of which recipe a number used
summary: Each recipe keeps its history; every product number shows which version it used.

title: Send supplier requests in waves
signal: Customers going to their first suppliers before the rest
summary: Plan supplier requests as waves and send the next wave when the first is done.

title: Report templates for the revised reporting scope
signal: The reporting rules changed in June; customers asked what it meant for them (customer webinar, 11 June)
summary: Corporate report templates updated to the revised scope, with a note on what changed.

title: Shorter farm questionnaire: twelve questions down to seven
signal: Every form sent to a farm spends goodwill (P-02)
summary: The farm form asks only what the calculation needs.

title: Factor library 2026.3: seafood and vegetables, about 6,400 factors
signal: Planned quarterly factor release
summary: About 650 new factors for seafood and vegetables.

title: Export file names carry the product name and date; the PDF shows the date of its data
signal: 'It should carry the product name and the date' (Fjordmelk, 25 Aug), raised earlier by Nordvik; confirmed fixed at the Nordvik QBR on 2 Sep
summary: Exported files are named by product and date, and every PDF states the date of the data behind it.

title: Invitation emails from a named address, with the company name in the subject
signal: Two of four brand contacts found the invitation in junk (Sydfood, 12 Aug); confirmed fixed on 9 Sep
summary: Colleague invitations come from a real sender and name the customer's company.

title: Inline help on the supplier screen columns
signal: 'I still do not really understand the supplier screen' (Fjordlaks, 14 Aug)
summary: Each column on the supplier screen explains itself on hover.

title: Approve the wording before a supplier request goes out
signal: Customers want to sign off the letter before suppliers see it (Nordflor kickoff, 7 Sep)
summary: A request waits for the customer's approval before it is sent.

title: Supplier screen opens sorted by emissions
signal: Raised in March and again on 14 Aug: 'still opens sorted alphabetically, which is why I never saw the thing you showed me' (Havsfisk). Pulled forward from the interface refresh in September
summary: The default sort is by emissions, so the finding is the first thing a user sees.

title: Exports keep the primary and average data flags
signal: An export that drops the flags (P-13, W35 and W36)
summary: Every exported line keeps its data quality flag.

title: Quarterly supplier ranking for purchasing, on one page
signal: Champions need something to take to purchasing (Fjordlaks, Sydfood, Havsfisk; W33, W34, W37)
summary: A one page PDF of the customer's own suppliers ranked by emissions, for purchasing.

title: Locked features say 'not in your package' instead of looking broken
signal: A locked module that looks broken (P-13)
summary: Features outside the customer's package explain why they are locked.

title: Product export shows material names, not internal codes
signal: 'Product export shows material codes' (Sydfood, 9 Sep)
summary: Exports use the customer's material names.

title: Label the boundary on both numbers on the product page
signal: 'The two numbers thing on the product page' (Nordvik, 2 Sep); two numbers on one page with the boundary in small print (P-13)
summary: Each number on the product page says what it covers, cradle to gate or cradle to shelf.

title: Unit conversions visible and editable on the product page
signal: A unit mismatch flagged in May that took months to explain (Nordolie, 20 Aug); a unit conversion nobody can find (P-13)
summary: Every conversion is shown next to the input and can be checked or changed.

title: Admin view: who logged in this quarter
signal: 'The fourteen brand managers... never once opened it' (Aalborg, 20 Aug); CSMs checking logins before reviews (Bergstrand, 14 Sep)
summary: Customer admins see who has used their seats this quarter.

title: Factor library 2026.4
signal: Planned quarterly factor release
summary: Quarterly factor release; scope set in October.

title: Factor version and data date on every report line
signal: 'Our auditors will ask' (Lindholm, 14 Aug)
summary: Each line in a report names the factor version and the date of the data behind it.

title: Invite a backup user: a prompt at month three
signal: There is no second person (P-01, 19 groups); 'if I get hit by a bus... Vänerns has nothing'
summary: At month three the only active user is asked to invite a backup.

title: Your name and signature on supplier requests
signal: The signature, not the template, decides whether a supplier answers (P-02, 13 groups; Nordflor kickoff, 7 Sep)
summary: Requests go out under the customer's name and signature, not Rootline's.

title: Change by cause on every article line in exports
signal: A grocer clause asks for each article's change from last year to be 'explained'; the split by cause exists for the group, and for articles 'it's the same logic one level down' (Tre Kronor, 7 Sep)
summary: Each exported article line carries its change since last year split into factor updates, the customer's own data and method. Today the split is on screen and in the group restatement, not in article exports.

title: Saved column mappings for recurring supplier files
signal: 'Two of my eleven send data in a format that has to be rebuilt by hand every quarter' (Bergstrand, 18 Aug)
summary: Map a supplier's file once; the next file in the same layout imports itself. Cancelled 1 October: supplier portal v2 (RL-600) lets suppliers answer in their own format, which replaces file mapping.

title: Hotspots page: top emission sources and what customers do next
signal: Head of CS: 'give them something to do next. A page, a screen... anything that is not the roadmap' (W36 pipeline review); the What happens next page (WHN, 10 Sep) is the CS version
summary: The ten largest sources, and the three things customers usually do next. Not a plan or a pathway.

title: Exports in every unit the product page shows: per pack, per litre, per kilo landed
signal: 'I had to redo the per can numbers for three can sizes by hand for the retailer, because the export only gave me per litre' (Bryggeri Kvarnen, 14 Sep; 'That's a known one. The export is being rebuilt'); fishing customers count fuel per kilo landed (Vinga, 17 Aug)
summary: Per can and per bottle figures already show on the product page; the export gives per litre only. This adds every unit to the export, plus per kilo landed for fisheries.

title: Change log export an assurance provider can read
signal: 'Two years of assurance history coming with me' (Bergstrand, 18 Aug)
summary: Export the full change log, with who, when and why, in a format an assurance provider can read.

title: Supplier answers keep the unit they were given in
signal: A supplier export in a different unit than expected, flagged in May (Nordolie, 20 Aug)
summary: The supplier's original unit is stored and shown next to the converted value.

title: Interface refresh, phase 1: supplier view and reporting export
signal: Raised all year: the supplier screen's alphabetical default since March (Havsfisk), 'I still do not really understand the supplier screen' (Fjordlaks, 14 Aug), an eleven item navigation (Aalborg exit, 20 Aug), and labels customers find before Rootline does (P-13, W35 and W36)
summary: First half of the UX rebuild: a supplier view that leads with emissions, and a reporting export that carries data flags, factor versions and dates. Scope grew in Q2 to take in the export, and the two designers were shared with scenario comparison from July, so it moved from Q1 to Q4. The release target is internal only; customers have been given no date.

title: Interface refresh, phase 2: the rest of the product
signal: Same signals as phase 1, plus occasional users who get lost in the navigation (Aalborg exit, 20 Aug)
summary: Navigation and the remaining screens. No work in 2026; it starts after phase 1 ships.

title: Faster data loading at group scale
signal: Slow loads first logged in December 2025 (P-07). A year of landings with no progress message (Fjordlaks, 14 Aug). Consolidation slow at four brands and timing out at five (Sydfood, 12 Aug, still true on 9 Sep)
summary: Three steps. Faster imports shipped in June, and customers noticed ('The loading speed is better', Havsfisk, 14 Aug). Progress messages come next. Consolidation past four entities comes last because it needs a change to the calculation. Customers have been told it is being worked on, with no date.

title: Faster data loading, step 1: imports twice as fast
signal: P-07, first logged December 2025
summary: Activity data and landing imports run about twice as fast. No change to how anything looks.

title: Faster data loading, step 2: progress messages on long loads
signal: 'No sign it is working' on a year of landings (Fjordlaks, 14 Aug)
summary: Long loads show what is happening and how far along they are, instead of a blank screen.

title: Faster data loading, step 3: consolidate five or more entities without a timeout
signal: Times out when a fifth brand is added (Sydfood, 12 Aug); 'not fixed... I don't have a date and I won't make one up' (Sydfood, 9 Sep)
summary: The consolidation view loads a group of any size. Until then the solutions engineer splits the view in two as a workaround.

title: Brand level read only views
signal: Asked for since spring: a purchasing manager with his own login since April (Tre Kronor, 27 Aug), a buyer asking for his own login unprompted (Lindholm, 14 Aug), and the exit that names it, 'a page that shows a brand manager his own brand and nothing else' (Aalborg, 20 Aug). Group customers hold 25 read only seats that brand managers rarely open (Bergstrand, 14 Sep)
summary: Give a brand manager, buyer or entity owner a view of their own brand and nothing else. Moved behind faster loading in the June re plan; design started in August and build starts in mid October.

title: Template export formats for customers and importers
signal: Customers map Rootline data into buyer and importer formats by hand (P-10), export buyers want it in their own scheme (Vinga, 25 Aug and 17 Sep), and a product export still shows internal material codes (Sydfood, 9 Sep). Three common formats are covered today ('we already export to all three', Vretstorp, 31 Aug)
summary: Add the grocer scorecard and importer formats customers keep rebuilding by hand. The Supply package promises exports in every standard template format, so each format closes a gap in that promise. The Products team's first half went to the versioned factor service, which ran a quarter late, so the build started in September.

title: Export format: grocer supplier scorecard
signal: Use case 1, answering the customer's scorecard before the deadline (P-05, 15 groups)
summary: Export straight into the scorecard format the largest grocers send their suppliers.

title: Export format: importer documentation for export markets
signal: Export buyers ask for documentation in their own format (P-10; Vinga, 25 Aug)
summary: Export in the documentation format importers outside the EU ask for most often.

title: Scenario comparison: swap a supplier, see the group number
public_roadmap: DECK-3: not on the slide. DECK-4: Next (in design)
target: early access 2026-11-16; general release not dated
signal: The most requested thing all year: asked for in April (Lindholm), raised by a fund and by boards (Aalborg, Kärnhuset, Nordkost), a renewal condition (Fjordgruppen), a lost evaluation ('On the roadmap means no', Storhaug, 28 Aug), and three of three W34 review and exit calls. Product chose scenario comparison over a costed abatement module in the June re plan; the head of product's written answer reached customers in August and September
summary: Model what the group footprint looks like if supplier A is swapped for supplier B, with data quality shown underneath. It is not reduction planning: no measure library, no cost per tonne, no pathway to a target year. Early access for a first group in November (Nordkost and Bergstrand are in). No general release date, and none has been given to customers.

title: Scenario comparison: early access for a first group
signal: Promised to Bergstrand (14 Sep) and Nordkost (24 Sep): early access in November, no general date
summary: A first group of customers uses what has been built by then, on a real decision. Not for board papers yet.

title: Supplier portal v2
signal: Supplier requests spend goodwill and only work with the right signature (P-02, 13 groups); suppliers send data in formats rebuilt by hand every quarter (Bergstrand, 18 Aug); a supplier export in the wrong unit, flagged in May (Nordolie, 20 Aug)
summary: Rebuild the supplier side: requests in the customer's name, answers in the supplier's own format and unit, farms answering on a phone. Moved to 2027 in the June re plan so the team could take scenario comparison. Discovery runs to the end of October; small fixes ship meanwhile.

title: Reduction planning: exploring
public_roadmap: DECK-3: Q4 2026, exploring. DECK-4: Later, exploring
signal: Same demand as RL-500. Customers ask for a costed pathway to a target year
summary: Costed abatement planning: a measure library, cost per tonne, a pathway to a target year. Customer research only. The head of product's written answer: no costed abatement planning module in the next four quarters, and no change without a decision that has not been made. Customers have been told so.

title: Beyond food and beverage: market exploration
signal: Asked for by the CEO. Leadership wants a path out of food and beverage (company file). Customer evidence points the other way: two non food accounts churned or will not renew (Nordpack, Renhold), and the CRO approved a second packaging account against the AE's objection (Nordisk Emballage, W36 pipeline review)
summary: A six week look at packaging makers as a second market. No customer asked for it. Factors, schema and supplier logic all assume food inputs.

title: Supplier evidence for deforestation (EUDR): discovery
signal: Asked for by the CEO after the September board (memo, 25 Sep): EUDR applies to large and medium operators from 30 December 2026. One customer conversation: Vretstorp's palm and soy, offered as an add on that is not on the price list. No feedback portal idea, no support ticket
summary: Discovery: could supplier answers carry the evidence EUDR asks for, beyond origin by country, as an add on? The head of product's time only in 2026, shared with RL-710 and RL-730. Build decision at the January planning.

title: A package for grocers: discovery
signal: Asked for by the CEO after the September board (memo, 25 Sep): grocers as customers, not only the reason customers buy. Two grocers pay today (Handelsbolaget Nord, Matkedjan Syd); grocers ask suppliers for proof (Gotlandskött's grocer, 1 December). The grocer scorecard export (RL-401) is 'the first step'
summary: Discovery: a package for grocers that use Rootline with their own brand suppliers. The head of product's time only in 2026. Decision at the January planning, with 2027 goals.

title: Carbon figure on pack for consumers
signal: A brewer whose shelf competitors print a figure on the can asks every couple of weeks (Falkenberg, 13 Aug)
summary: Declined in April: consumer claims carry a legal and method burden the product is not built for. Kept on the asked for, not served list.

title: Packaging chemical compliance (PFAS)
signal: A packaging customer asked; out of scope since the November 2025 packaging
summary: Out of scope by design ('What neither package does'). Declined again when a packaging customer asked.

title: Read only archive after a contract ends
signal: 'How much would it cost to keep it in a... frozen state?' (Kallvatten, 3 Sep); buyers negotiating the exit, not the price (P-15)
summary: Declined in September with the CRO: a live subscription or an export, nothing in between. The change log export (RL-050) covers the assurance history part of the ask.

title: Versioned factor service
team: Products, with the factor data team
signal: Engineering: factor versions were stored inside each calculation, which made factor updates slow and factor versions impossible to print
summary: Moves the factor library to a versioned service. Nothing changes on screen. It is what lets factor versions appear on report lines (RL-043) and consolidation scale (RL-203).

title: Account usage page for customer success
signal: CSMs wanted to see logins before reviews instead of asking support
summary: Internal page for CSMs: last login per user, per account.
